description: Lists file identities, sizes, and line counts without contents, sorted by type then name with cursor pagination (default 20, maximum 100). Filter by name with `nameGlob`. Defaults to head; pass `target=published` or an explicit `version`, and pin continuation requests to the resolved response version.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Continue with the returned resolved version to keep the listing pinned.

limit.description: Maximum files to return. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 100.

nameGlob.description: Only list files whose name matches this glob. `*` and `?` stop at a `/` segment boundary; `**` crosses them, for example `blog/**`.

version.description: Explicit source version. Takes precedence over `target`.

name: websiteSourceCode_files_list
title: List source files
